kickoff.title: Kickoff with your Exos rollout rep
kickoff.why: Sets the go-live date, who your site owner(s) and MC administrator are, and which systems you bring up first.
steps: Book a 45-minute kickoff with your Exos rollout rep.
Name your site owner(s): the one or two people who decide which Mission Control features your organization uses. Site owners can change Settings > Features.
Name one MC administrator (adds users, assigns roles). Can be the same person as a site owner.
Agree the go-live date and the order systems come up (this board is already in a sensible order: platform → people → work management → finance → operations).
List the data you will bring over: customer/contact list, supplier list, open purchase orders, parts/BOM lists, asset list, open jobs.
Post the agreed date, site owner(s) and administrator as a note on this task.
kickoff.done: Go-live date, site owner(s) and administrator are recorded in a note on this task.
kickoff.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

settings.title: Confirm the features switched on in Settings
settings.why: Every task on this board is generated from Settings > Features. Turning a feature on adds its setup task here; turning it off removes it (or cancels it if work already started).
steps: Site owner: open Settings (left nav → Settings → Features).
Review each group: Work management, Relationships & revenue, Finance & operations, Manufacturing, People & compliance, AI, Platform, Integrations.
Core items are always on. Tick the Business/Enterprise items you want; untick anything you will not use in the first 90 days.
Click Save selection. The task board updates within a minute.
Anything missing from the menu: use the request box on the same page.
settings.done: Selection saved and the board shows one setup task per feature you want.
settings.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

golive.title: Go-live review and sign-off
golive.why: Confirms every selected system works with your own data before you rely on it.
steps: Check that every other task in the Startup category on this board is Done or deliberately Cancelled.
Run one real transaction end to end in each area you switched on (e.g. a task, a supplier PO, an expense report, a receipt).
Your Exos rollout rep reviews access logs and the backup/recovery check with you.
Agree the support path after go-live (who to call, response times).
Mark this task Done.
golive.done: Sign-off note posted and this task marked Done.
golive.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

roles.title: Add your people and assign roles
roles.why: Nothing else on this board moves until each setup task has a named owner. This task puts your people in, gives each the right access, and hands out the rest of the board.
steps: List your first-wave people: name, work email, job title. Start with the site owner(s), the MC administrator and one lead per area below; add everyone else at go-live.

Your administrator opens Admin (left nav → Admin) and clicks + Add User for each person. Roles: admin (everything, including Settings and users), manager (approves, edits Settings), member (own and shared tasks), partner/board (read-only portals).
Each new user gets a temporary password and sets their own at first login.
Send the same email list to your Exos rollout rep, who adds it to the secure-access policy. Without that step people cannot reach the login page.

Name a person for each area lead: MC administrator; Finance lead (accounting, suppliers, expenses, job cost); Operations lead (approvals, equipment, inventory, production); Sales / business development lead (customers, pipeline, bids); HR / people lead (staff directory, policies, ethics line). One person can hold several.
Open the Startup tasks on this board. Each one says "Suggested owner" — set the Owner field to that person.
Post the list of people and area leads as a note on this task.
roles.done: Every first-wave user can log in, and every open Startup task has a named owner.
roles.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

cloudflare.title: Secure access (Cloudflare Zero Trust)
cloudflare.why: Mission Control has no open ports. People reach it through an identity check (one-time PIN to their email) before the login page.
steps: Send your Exos rollout rep the list of user email addresses (same list as Admin).
The rep adds them to your workspace's access policy.
Each user opens the workspace link, enters their email, and types the PIN that arrives by email.
If a PIN does not arrive, check spam/quarantine and allow the sender (Cloudflare Access).
Removing someone: tell the rep the same day; Admin → Disable the user.
cloudflare.done: Every user on the list has reached the MC login page once.
cloudflare.rep: Your Exos rollout rep does this step for you.

guard.title: Security monitoring (MC Guard) — confirm and review
guard.why: Every request is filtered, rate-limited and logged. Nothing to install; this task is the review.
steps: Ask your Exos rollout rep for the first-week access summary (logins, denied requests).
Confirm no unexpected users or locations.
Agree who in your organization receives security notices.
guard.done: First-week access summary reviewed and a security contact named.
guard.rep: Your Exos rollout rep runs the report with you.

supabase.title: Database and backups — confirm
supabase.why: Your workspace keeps its own database, separate from every other organization. This task confirms storage and backup.
steps: Your workspace currently stores data in its own encrypted volume on the Exos host.
Ask your Exos rollout rep to show you the last backup time and run a test restore of one record.
Decide retention: how long deleted items stay recoverable (default 90 days).
If you prefer a hosted database in your own account, tell the rep before go-live.
supabase.done: Backup confirmed and a test restore completed.
supabase.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

partnerview.title: Partner / board portals
partnerview.why: Read-only views for directors, partners or customers, with nothing else visible.
steps: List who needs a portal and what they should see (e.g. board packs, a partner's project).
Your Exos rollout rep creates the portal and its user accounts with the partner/board role.
Log in as a test portal user with the rep and confirm only the intended items show.
partnerview.done: Each portal user can log in and sees only their scoped view.
partnerview.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

tasks.title: Jobs & Tasks — load your work
tasks.why: The board is where every job, action item and question lives, each with an owner and due date.
steps: Open Tasks (left nav).
Click + Add for each open job or action item: title, owner, due date, category.
Use the category list to group work (e.g. Projects, Board, Customers, Suppliers).
Open a task to add notes, questions and documents; every change is logged in its timeline.
Bulk import: send your Exos rollout rep a spreadsheet (title, owner, due date, category, description) and it is loaded for you.
Owners: tasks owned by 'Team' are visible to every member; tasks owned by a person are visible to that person and to managers.
tasks.done: Your open work is on the board with owners and due dates.
tasks.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

decisions.title: Decisions queue — set approvers
decisions.why: One-click approve / hold / drop cards for whoever approves spending, documents and plans.
steps: Name your approvers (usually the CEO and one backup).
Make sure each approver has a manager or admin account (Users task).
Open Decisions (left nav) to see waiting cards. Each card shows the recommendation, the reason and the options.
Click a choice to answer; add a note if you want something changed. The answer goes back to the related task automatically.
decisions.done: Approvers named and one test decision answered.
decisions.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

dashboard.title: My Dashboard — set the company default view
dashboard.why: Each person's landing page: their tasks, deadlines and items needing attention.
steps: Open My Dashboard.
Click ☰ Widgets and choose what everyone should see by default.
An admin clicks Set as Company Default. Each user can still adjust their own.
dashboard.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

followups.title: Follow-ups — turn on reminders
followups.why: Dated reminders so nothing you send goes unanswered.
steps: Open Follow-ups.
Follow-ups are created from tasks and contacts with a date. Mark ✓ Replied when the answer arrives, or Dismiss.
Agree a weekly habit: each owner clears their follow-ups every Monday.
followups.done: Each owner has seen the Follow-ups page and the weekly habit is agreed.
followups.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

search.title: Global search — check it finds your records
search.why: One search box across tasks, contacts, companies and documents.
steps: After loading tasks and contacts, search for three things you know exist.
If something is missing, tell your Exos rollout rep.
search.done: Three known records found by search.
search.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

crm.title: CRM & Contacts — import customers and contacts
crm.why: Companies, contacts, deals and activity history in one place.
steps: Export your current customer/contact list (from email, spreadsheet or an old CRM) to a spreadsheet: company, name, title, email, phone, notes.
Send it to your Exos rollout rep for import, or add records by hand with + Add.
Open a contact and click + Log Activity to record a call or meeting; + Add Task to create a follow-up.
Use Export CSV any time to take your data out.
crm.done: Your active customers and contacts are in the CRM.
crm.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

opportunities.title: Opportunities pipeline — load open bids and deals
opportunities.why: Ranked pipeline of bids, grants and deals by value and deadline.
steps: List every open opportunity: name, customer/agency, value, due date, stage.
Enter each one on Opportunities (or send the list to your Exos rollout rep).
Use Close out when an opportunity is won, lost or dropped, so the pipeline stays current.
Agree a weekly pipeline review.
opportunities.done: Open opportunities are loaded with values and due dates.
opportunities.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

reading.title: Required reading — assign policies
reading.why: Assign policies (handbook, safety, export rules) and track who has read them.
steps: Collect the policies everyone must read.
Upload each policy and assign it to the people or roles who must read it.
Check the acknowledgment list after one week and chase anyone outstanding.
reading.done: Core policies assigned and acknowledgments tracked.
reading.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

quickbooks.title: Connect QuickBooks Online
quickbooks.why: Finance, supplier, PO and job-cost pages read and write your own QuickBooks company file.
steps: Your QuickBooks admin signs in when your Exos rollout rep sends the connection link (standard QuickBooks authorization screen) and approves access for Mission Control.
Confirm the company name shown is your company, not another file.
The rep runs a read test: vendors, accounts and open bills appear in MC.
Agree which actions MC may post to QuickBooks (e.g. approved purchase orders only).
Nothing is written to QuickBooks until a person approves it in MC.
quickbooks.done: MC shows your QuickBooks vendors and accounts, and write permissions are agreed.
quickbooks.rep: Your QuickBooks admin signs in once; your Exos rollout rep does the rest.

suppliers.title: Suppliers & POs — load suppliers and open POs
suppliers.why: Supplier records, due diligence and purchase orders, synced to QuickBooks after approval.
steps: Open Suppliers & POs. With QuickBooks connected, your vendors appear automatically; otherwise click ＋ New supplier.
For each active supplier, complete contact, terms and any certifications.
Create a test PO: ＋ New PO → add lines (＋ Line) → Save & submit for approval.
An approver opens it and clicks ✓ Approve → QuickBooks. Check the PO appears in QuickBooks with the same number.
When goods arrive, use Log receipt on the PO (or the Receiving page). Rejected quantities open a quality record automatically.
Load your other open POs the same way, or send the list to your Exos rollout rep.
suppliers.done: Active suppliers loaded and one PO approved through to QuickBooks.
suppliers.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

expenses.title: Expense reports — set approvers and categories
expenses.why: Staff submit expenses with receipts; managers approve; approved reports export to accounting.
steps: Agree expense categories (match your QuickBooks expense accounts).
Name who approves expenses for each team.
One person submits a test report: + Add line for each item, attach receipts, Submit for approval.
The approver approves it and confirms the export is correct.
expenses.done: One test expense report submitted, approved and exported.
expenses.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

jobcost.title: Job costing — set up jobs and labor rates
jobcost.why: Labor and material cost rolled up per job or contract.
steps: List your active jobs/contracts with a job number each.
Give your Exos rollout rep loaded labor rates by role (or connect your HR system).
Confirm that POs and time entries carry the job number.
Open Job Costing and check one job's totals against your own numbers.
jobcost.done: Active jobs loaded and one job's cost checked against your records.
jobcost.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

assets.title: Asset register — load equipment
assets.why: Tracks equipment and assets: what you own, where it is, its condition.
steps: Export your fixed-asset or equipment list: description, tag/serial, location, value, date acquired.
Send it to your Exos rollout rep for import, or enter items on the Asset Register.
Walk the floor and confirm the top 20 items by value.
assets.done: Asset list loaded and high-value items checked.
assets.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

mrp.title: MRP — load bills of materials and run the first plan
mrp.why: Material requirements planning: what to buy, and when, from your bills of materials and stock.
steps: Collect bills of materials for each product or assembly: part number, description, quantity per, preferred supplier, lead time.
Send them to your Exos rollout rep for loading (spreadsheet is fine).
Complete the Receiving & inventory task first so stock on hand is right.
Open MRP and click Run MRP. Review the shortages it lists.
For a shortage, Make PO draft creates a draft PO on Suppliers & POs for approval.
mrp.done: BOMs loaded, MRP run, and the shortage list checked against what you expect.
mrp.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

production.title: Production control — set up work orders
production.why: Work orders and build status on the shop floor; rejected parts open quality records.
steps: List the products or assemblies you build and their main steps.
Your Exos rollout rep sets up the work-order template with you.
Open a test work order, move it through each step, and close it.
Confirm quality records (NCRs) appear when a received part is rejected.
production.done: One test work order completed end to end.
production.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

receiving.title: Receiving & inventory — count and load stock
receiving.why: Receive against POs, keep shop inventory with photos, and track shortfalls.
steps: Decide storage locations (rooms, shelves, bins) and label them.
Do a starting count. Send the count sheet (part number, description, quantity, location) to your Exos rollout rep, or enter it on Shop Inventory.
Test a receipt: open Receiving, 📷 photo the packing list, then ✓ Check in received parts against the PO.
Use Export CSV on Shop Inventory to check totals against your count.
receiving.done: Starting stock loaded and one receipt checked in against a PO.
receiving.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

hr.title: HR directory — connect your staff list
hr.why: Read-only staff directory and org chart.
steps: If you use BambooHR, complete the BambooHR task; the directory fills automatically.
Otherwise send your Exos rollout rep a staff list: name, title, department, manager, email.
Check the org chart (🖨 Org chart) is right.
hr.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

ethics.title: Ethics & whistleblower reporting — confirm the channel
ethics.why: A confidential reporting channel, as your employee handbook requires.
steps: Name who receives reports (and a backup who is independent of management).
Your Exos rollout rep sets the recipients.
Submit a test report marked TEST, check it arrives, then close it.
Tell staff where the report page is.
ethics.done: Recipients set and a test report received.
ethics.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

agent.title: AI assistant — learn how to use it
agent.why: The assistant answers questions on tasks, drafts documents and emails, does research and files results back to the task.
steps: Open any task and add a note starting with a question; the assistant answers in the task.
Ask it for a draft (letter, PO description, meeting agenda); the draft is attached to the task for your review.
Nothing is sent outside your organization without a person approving it.
Agree with your Exos rollout rep what the assistant may and may not do (e.g. no export-controlled technical data).
agent.done: Each first-wave user has asked the assistant one question on a task.
agent.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

claude.title: AI model connection — confirm
claude.why: The AI model behind the assistant. Your Exos rollout rep manages the connection.
steps: Your Exos rollout rep confirms the model connection for your workspace.
Review the data-handling note: what is sent to the model and what is not.
claude.done: Connection confirmed and data-handling note reviewed.
claude.rep: Your Exos rollout rep does this step for you.

localai.title: Private / local AI models
localai.why: Sensitive work runs on models inside the workspace, so the data never leaves it.
steps: List the kinds of work that must stay private.
Your Exos rollout rep sizes and enables the local model and routes that work to it.
localai.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

altmodels.title: Additional AI model providers
steps: Tell your Exos rollout rep which providers you approve.
The rep enables them and confirms routing.
altmodels.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

ollama.title: Local model runtime
steps: Your Exos rollout rep installs and tests the runtime with you.
ollama.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

websearch.title: Web research
websearch.why: Sourced web search for research briefs.
steps: Your Exos rollout rep enables search for your workspace.
Ask the assistant one research question on a task and check the sources it cites.
websearch.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

bamboohr.title: Connect BambooHR
bamboohr.why: Directory, org chart and labor rates from your HR system.
steps: Your BambooHR admin creates an API key for Mission Control.
Your Exos rollout rep enters it securely (never by email or chat).
Check the directory fills in.
bamboohr.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

proton.title: Connect email (Proton Mail)
proton.why: Inbound email becomes CRM activity or tasks; drafts go out from your own mailbox.
steps: Choose which mailbox(es) to connect.
Your Exos rollout rep sets up the connection with you on a screen-share.
Send a test email and check it appears as CRM activity.
proton.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

m365.title: Connect Microsoft 365
m365.why: Mail, calendar and documents from Microsoft 365.
steps: Your Microsoft 365 admin approves the Mission Control app (one consent screen).
Your Exos rollout rep tests mail and calendar access.
m365.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

discord.title: Connect team chat (Discord)
discord.why: Decisions and task notifications in your team channels.
steps: Choose the channels.
Your Exos rollout rep adds the bot and tests a notification.
discord.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

teamwork.title: Connect Teamwork.com
steps: Your Teamwork admin creates an API key.
Your Exos rollout rep connects it and syncs one project as a test.
teamwork.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

docusign.title: Connect DocuSign
docusign.why: Send envelopes through DocuSign when a counterparty requires it.
steps: Your DocuSign admin authorizes Mission Control.
Send a test envelope to yourself.
docusign.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

peony.title: Connect Peony data room
peony.why: Push documents to an external Peony room.
steps: Your Exos rollout rep connects your Peony account and pushes one test document.
peony.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

samgov.title: SAM.gov opportunity search
samgov.why: Federal opportunity search into your pipeline.
steps: Give your Exos rollout rep your NAICS codes and keywords.
Review the first week's matches on Opportunities.
samgov.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.

csl.title: Denied-party screening
csl.why: Screens new contacts and suppliers against the U.S. Consolidated Screening List.
steps: Your Exos rollout rep enables screening.
Review the first screening results and name who clears possible matches.
csl.done: Screening on and a reviewer named.
csl.rep: Your Exos rollout rep walks you through this on a screen-share and can do the setup steps for you.
